original_test_intent: Verify the complete PCIe hierarchy matches the approved platform topology, including every root port, switch, bridge, endpoint identity, slot and negotiated link state.
original_method: Pin read-only vendor topology module/config; capture stable serial/UUID/BDF/device IDs plus parent-child paths; preserve logs; load approved topology graph with optional/disabled nodes; normalize enumeration without losing identity; compare nodes, edges, counts and speed/width; retain unexpected/missing/duplicate paths and health evidence.
manual_activity: Platform owner provides the approved topology/optional-device graph; collection and graph comparison can then be automated.
required_inputs: Signed topology artifact/config and read-only proof
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or retrain/reset devices
Do not compare solely by volatile BDF order
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete live topology and link state

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A vendor topology readout is useful but cannot judge correctness without a reference graph and stable identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the reviewed read-only module and corroborate with identity-aware PCIe inventory/link evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System-topology qualification remains the complete graph, not a subset or screenshot.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare expected and observed labeled graphs by physical identity, then validate negotiated speed/width on every edge.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Firmware/readability and performance tests cannot prove node/edge completeness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BDFs can change across firmware settings; stable physical labels are required for durable comparison.

project_override_considerations: Project recipe defines optional slots/functions and acceptable alternate enumeration paths.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure names PCIe system-topology qualification, while Criteria only check readable text and firmware and do not define topology correctness.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only collection is possible; the expected graph is a provisionable project input.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row322 Wistron-NV GPU-00315-V003: approve exact read-only topology module/config and authoritative labeled root-port/switch/bridge/endpoint graph, optional-node and speed/width rules, firmware reference, and map or replace unrelated Criteria while preserving logs.

review_improvement: Makes topology a graph-completeness and link-state check rather than a visually readable dump.
independent_technical_reasoning: A flat device list cannot prove parent-child wiring, and volatile BDF ordering can change without a physical defect. Stable identities and graph edges are the required invariants for detecting missing, swapped or unexpectedly routed endpoints.
